# `/roadmap`

> Generate or update the feature roadmap from the PRD

<!-- generated by scripts/gen-command-docs.py from commands/roadmap.md — do not edit -->

Breaks the PRD into ordered features `F-001…` with dependencies, sizes and milestones.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Usage** | `/roadmap` |
| **Reads** | `PRD.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `DESIGN.md` |
| **Writes** | `specs/roadmap.md` |
| **Gates** | You approve scope and order. Statuses in this file are informational: they are derived by `/status`. |
| **Next** | `/specify` |
| **Tools** | `Bash(ls:*), Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob` |
